findings.title: Notices raised during SSH full screen are never drawn, and info notices expire unseen (D325 says they are deferred)
findings.evidence: The full-screen branch draws only ssh_view (grid + ' SSH <target>' row) and returns before status_bar/notice_rows. App::tick (app.rs:1106) still drops Info notices after INFO_NOTICE_TTL (5 s), whatever is on screen. Reachable: session A is full screen; a second session B whose probe finishes after the user typed into A gets push_tab(..,false) + info 'SSH B ready — click its tab' (commands/ssh.rs open); B logging in while A has the window gives 'SSH B: logged in; choose its tab for full screen' (ssh.rs poll; the test sec_s8_* asserts the notice exists while full_screen(a) is true). Also F1 > 'Toggle Blame Annotations' from full screen outside a repo, or ctrl+f7's 'Terminal panel on the right'. Result: B waits at a hidden password prompt and the user is never told; D325 ('notices deferred while full screen') is not implemented — they are discarded.
findings.fix_suggestion: While full_screen(app) is true, do not age Info notices (push back expires, or store a 'shown_at' and start the TTL on the first frame that draws the status bar); optionally show a '1 notice' marker on the SSH status row. Add a test: notice raised in full screen, tick past 5 s, ctrl+` -> notice drawn.

findings.title: FR-19 tab drag cannot move a logged-in SSH tab: the press enters full screen and cancels the drag, and the drag/release reach the remote program
findings.evidence: On MK::Down on a tab label the handler sets tab_drag = Some(i) and then calls enter_full(app) (FR-25), which sets tab_drag = None and removes the tab bar. A user dragging a logged-in 'ssh host' tab to reorder it gets full screen instead; the tab can never be reordered. The following Drag/Up events are routed to the full-screen grid with captured=false/selecting=false; when the remote program has mouse reporting on (tmux, vim) they are forwarded by forward_mouse as button-motion/release with no preceding press, which tmux reads as a drag start (copy-mode selection).
findings.fix_suggestion: Enter full screen on the release of a press that did not move the tab (MK::Up with tab_drag still on the pressed index and no drag_tab_to step), not on the press; or swallow events until the release after enter_full. Test: press on a logged-in SSH tab, drag two cells, release -> tab moved, not full screen, no bytes sent to the PTY.

findings.title: Palette 'Focus Editor' does nothing from SSH full screen
findings.evidence: Full screen stores ssh_view::layout (editor height 0) in app.layout, so editor_covered(app) is true; after the palette closes focus is back on the terminal, has_keys is true, and focus_editor returns early. F1 > Focus Editor in full screen silently keeps the session; only ctrl+` leaves.
findings.fix_suggestion: In focus_editor treat full_screen/app.terminal.full as not covered (clear full and give the editor the keys), or check editor_covered only when !app.terminal.full.

findings.title: ctrl+f8/ctrl+f9 in SSH full screen change the wrong, invisible panel size
findings.evidence: FR-24 keeps ctrl+f8/f9 in a focused terminal and FR-25 keeps them in full screen. With the full-screen layout, layout.tabs.width = 0, so right_now() is false even when the panel is on the right; step_size then edits height_percent (the bottom height) using lo/hi computed from the whole-window grid. The user sees nothing change, and after ctrl+` a bottom panel may be larger/smaller than before while a right panel is unchanged.
findings.fix_suggestion: Make grow/shrink (and toggle_position) no-ops with a short note while app.terminal.full, or compute right/limits from the panel layout rather than the full-screen layout.

findings.title: Docs: Enter on an exited terminal 'starts a new shell' — an SSH tab reconnects; recent list timing differs from README
findings.evidence: keymap.md Terminal row still says 'After the program exits, enter starts a new shell in the tab'; for an SSH tab handle_key calls ssh::reconnect. README says recent targets are 'recorded after a successful login', but ssh::poll also records on Exited(0), which is the only path when ssh_fullscreen = false (sessions are never logged_in).
findings.fix_suggestion: keymap.md: '... starts a new shell in the tab (an SSH tab connects to the same target again)'. README: 'recorded after a successful login, or a clean exit when ssh_fullscreen = false'.

findings.title: capabilities.md is stale after FR-25/26/28
findings.evidence: Line 76 lists terminal_view::cell_style(.., Option<&AnsiPalette>) as the drawing entry; it is now #[cfg(test)] only and theme_cell_style(cell, &Theme, depth) + Theme.terminal_{fg,bg,selection} are what views must use. No entry for the FR-25 reusables (terminal::spawn_program/push_tab/replace_term/enter_full/full_screen/sync_full, vr_term::SpawnExtras + marker scan, ssh::Target::parse, ssh::config::hosts, App.input_count) or FR-28 RowFit/wrap_cut. Line 107 lists Options without user_timeout.
findings.fix_suggestion: Update line 76 to theme_cell_style, add one line each for FR-25 / FR-26 / FR-28 reusables, add user_timeout and Request::FileBlame to line 107.
